description: jobs: Cancel a job. POST /v1/jobs/{id}/cancel. Cancels a job that is still queued. A running, finished, expired or already cancelled job is unchanged. Cancelling costs 0 credits. Costs 0 credits when it succeeds. Errors, blocked or timed-out requests, invalid requests and cache hits cost nothing. A not-found or empty result is charged only where that operation's published cost says so.

id.description: Job id from the 202 response. Pass that id and nothing else.
